"SQUATS NEVER STOP"
Day: 10 Thursday 10-10-24

Warm Up: Practice Doing some
"Unbroken Sets" of back Squats. These
are done with absolutely no pauses
or breaks during the set. The reps
go down and up continuously until
the set is done.

1. BACK SQUAT "UNBROKEN"
6 sets of 6 reps @ 65%
6 total sets, 36 total reps, 2min rest

2. BENCH PRESS "UNBROKEN"
5 sets of 8 reps @ 65%
2min rest

Cardio
EZ Bar/or BB
Skullcrushers x50 reps
"UNBROKEN"

Recovery
Salisbury steak
and gravy
Mashed tators
30 Min walk
8+ hrs sleep
